title.zh-CN: 多年夜间憋醒与逐渐加重的呼吸困难
title.en: Years of nocturnal choking with worsening breathlessness

summary.zh-CN: 长期睡眠呼吸问题在多次局部手术后仍存在，伴体貌与多层气道异常，需要重新寻找共同原因。
summary.en: Sleep-related breathing problems persist despite local operations, with changes in appearance and multilevel airway abnormalities.

provenance.citation: 牛红丽, 王海播, 张瑞, 马利军. 肢端肥大症合并阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停综合征及胸骨后甲状腺肿一例. 中华结核和呼吸杂志. 2011;34(11):862-864. doi: 10.3760/cma.j.issn.1001-0939.2011.11.023.

notes.en: Based on one published case. Times are relative, names are pseudonyms, and hospital/identifying details are removed. Dialogue, phases, questions and scoring are educational design.

guidelines: 14th acromegaly consensus, issue 2024, checked 2026-10-28; scope age-adjusted IGF-1 and multidisciplinary assessment, not retrospective resolution of conflicting operative history.

answer.zh-CN: 多年打鼾、睡眠反复呼吸暂停憋醒，白天嗜睡。
answer.en: There were years of snoring, recurrent sleep apnoeas and choking awakenings with daytime sleepiness.

answer.en: Severe abnormalities on sleep testing twelve years earlier led to palatal surgery, without clear symptom or AHI improvement.

name.en: Historical sleep study and current blood gases

en: Historical sleep study and current blood gases

text.zh-CN: 旧PSG AHI45次/小时、最低SaO2 55%。本次吸氧2 L/min时PaO2约31 mmHg、PaCO2约58–59 mmHg；本次未做完整PSG。原文夜间SpO2最低15%未经波形核验，不作实时模拟。
text.en: Historical PSG showed AHI 45/hour and nadir SaO2 55%. Current oxygen at 2 L/min accompanied PaO2 about 31 mmHg and PaCO2 about 58–59 mmHg; no complete current PSG was performed. A source nadir SpO2 of 15% lacks waveform verification and is not simulated.

text.zh-CN: CT示胸骨后甲状腺肿压迫气管、上气道弥漫肥厚；垂体占位约1.2×1.6×1.6 cm。GH41.2 mU/L，糖负荷不抑制；未提供IGF-1。
text.en: CT showed retrosternal goitre compressing the trachea and diffuse upper-airway thickening; a pituitary lesion measured about 1.2×1.6×1.6 cm. GH was 41.2 mU/L without glucose suppression; IGF-1 was not supplied.

text.zh-CN: 原文一段称气管造口、甲状腺及垂体手术后拔管；另一段称垂体瘤不宜手术，仅CPAP改善。两种叙述冲突，不能重建确定手术时间线；共同记载呼吸表现改善。
text.en: One source passage describes tracheostomy, thyroid and pituitary operations followed by decannulation; another says pituitary surgery was unsuitable and CPAP alone improved symptoms. These conflict, so a definite operative timeline cannot be reconstructed; both describe respiratory improvement.

prompt.zh-CN: 反复局部手术疗效差提示什么？
prompt.en: What does poor response to repeated local surgery suggest?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅当前阶段的检查记录，再比较不同解释。
need.en: Review the current investigation records before comparing explanations.

text.zh-CN: 可能存在多层气道问题和系统性软组织增生，不能只归于单个咽部病灶
text.en: Multilevel airway disease and systemic tissue growth may coexist beyond one pharyngeal lesion

feedback.zh-CN: 体貌、舌咽肥厚及胸骨后压迫需要综合解释。
feedback.en: Appearance, pharyngeal enlargement and retrosternal compression require integration.

text.zh-CN: 手术做过说明气道已正常
text.en: Previous surgery means the airway is normal

feedback.zh-CN: 实际仍有明显呼吸困难和低氧。

text.zh-CN: 只减重就能解释全部病变
text.en: Weight management alone explains every abnormality

feedback.zh-CN: 垂体和组织形态线索不能忽略。
feedback.en: Pituitary and tissue findings cannot be ignored.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: 表型、GH和垂体影像支持原报告肢端肥大症判断，但现代生化复核仍缺IGF-1
text.en: Phenotype, GH and pituitary imaging support the historical acromegaly diagnosis, with IGF-1 missing for modern biochemical review

feedback.zh-CN: 不能把未报告IGF-1补成正常或升高。
feedback.en: Unreported IGF-1 cannot be assumed normal or elevated.

text.zh-CN: 甲状腺激素正常即可排除气管受压
text.en: Normal thyroid hormones exclude tracheal compression

feedback.zh-CN: 结构性压迫与激素功能不同。
feedback.en: Structural compression differs from hormonal function.

text.zh-CN: 旧AHI就是本次完整睡眠监测结果
text.en: The old AHI is a complete current sleep study

feedback.zh-CN: 原文明示本次未做完整PSG。
feedback.en: The source explicitly says no complete current PSG.

prompt.zh-CN: 当前安全路径应怎样表述？
prompt.en: How should the current safety pathway be stated?

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 先由有经验气道与重症团队稳定呼吸，联合垂体、甲状腺和睡眠团队评估
text.en: Experienced airway/critical-care teams should stabilise breathing with coordinated pituitary, thyroid and sleep assessment

feedback.zh-CN: 严重多层阻塞和低氧需要联合规划，不能仅按一个病灶决定。
feedback.en: Severe multilevel obstruction and hypoxaemia require coordinated planning.

text.zh-CN: 任何固定性气道受压都只需居家CPAP

feedback.zh-CN: 危重气道受压可能需要专业气道干预。
feedback.en: Critical compression may require specialist airway intervention.

text.zh-CN: 从相互冲突的术后叙述任意选一段当事实

feedback.zh-CN: 源中手术与非手术结局互相矛盾，必须明示。

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 说明多层结构改变共同影响通气。；承认缺少IGF-1、当前PSG、可核验极低SpO2波形和一致手术结局。，用复述确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain that Multilevel structural changes jointly affect ventilation.; acknowledge IGF-1, current PSG, verifiable extreme-SpO2 waveforms and a consistent operative outcome are missing. and check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 报告提出肢端肥大症、睡眠呼吸暂停和胸骨后甲状腺压迫并存，但治疗结局叙述存在内部冲突。
conclusion.en: The report describes coexisting acromegaly, sleep apnoea and retrosternal thyroid compression, with internally conflicting treatment outcomes.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 多层结构改变共同影响通气。
keyReasoning.en: Multilevel structural changes jointly affect ventilation.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: GH和表型支持进一步垂体评估。
keyReasoning.en: GH and phenotype support further pituitary assessment.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 源文冲突限制结局重建。

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 结构正常不能由激素正常推出。
teachingPoints.en: Normal hormones do not establish normal structure.
Separate historical PSG from current monitoring.
Do not invent a definite operative outcome.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.
